Newton's Second Law famously related acceleration to force and mass. What's the relationship between force and acceleration?

```{mcq}
#| label: mfh-1-u04
1. Acceleration is proportional to force. [correct hint: Yes. The constant of proportionality is called *mass*.]
2. Acceleration is the derivative of force with respect to time.
3. Acceleration is the accumulation of force with respect to time. 
4. Acceleration and force have unrelated dimensions.
```

:::
 <!-- end of exr-maple-freeze-hat -->
